subject: Web Development
title: Painting and Compositing
description: A short lesson to help you apply Painting and Compositing.

hook.text: After layout, the browser knows where every box goes. Now it must fill them with pixels.

buildup.text: Painting converts boxes into actual colors, text, shadows, and images on screen.

discovery.text: Complex pages are split into layers. Each layer is painted independently, then stacked.

twist.text: Compositing happens on the GPU. That's why CSS transforms and opacity animate so smoothly.

climax.text: Browsers paint in layers to avoid redrawing the whole page when one element changes.

quiz.question: Why do browsers use compositing layers?
options: To avoid redrawing the whole page
